assumptions: independent stationary repetitions; arbitrary dependence among replicas and members within each PUB shot
union bounds across PUBs; no independence assumption between PUBs or jobs
directional rejection uses the one-sided alpha radius; displayed intervals use the two-sided alpha radius
endpoint_analysis.method: shared planning/collection Hoeffding bounds grouped by immutable PUB identity

interpretation: Joint event covariance uses same-PUB shot positions; different PUBs and jobs have no paired observations.
Deterministic errors exist only when the declared ideal outcome has probability one.
Shot-order blocks are descriptive index windows, not per-shot wall-clock timestamps or drift tests.
Residuals are descriptive; hardware alone does not identify model error or finite simulation uncertainty.
Basis probabilities do not establish state fidelity, amplitude phases, or crosstalk causality.
Qubit-shot totals count each distinct active or reserved physical qubit once per PUB shot.

throughput.goodput_withheld: a scientifically justified independent-evidence or fidelity unit is undefined
throughput.scope: occupancy and sampling throughput; physical PUB-shots remain the vendor sampling unit
